channel.title: U.S. Right to Know – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from U.S. Right to Know – Bias and Credibility (usrtk.org)

item.title: Tracing Bayer’s ties to power in Trump’s Washington
item.description: From lobby firms to top officials, a look at how Bayer built access and secured favors from Trump's Washington.

item.title: Air pollution tied to brain aging, memory loss later in life, study finds
item.description: Older adults exposed to high air pollution in the early 2000s had worse memory in 2011 — even after air quality improved, a new study has found.

item.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to back Bayer again, aided by officials who came from Bayer’s law firms
item.description: The Trump administration yesterday urged the Supreme Court to side with the German pesticide company Bayer in a high-stakes legal case.

item.title: NIH files reveal broader coronavirus engineering research before COVID-19
item.description: Scientists across multiple U.S.-funded projects proposed altering spike proteins and cleavage sites in bat viruses.

item.title: Emails show Wuhan scientist suggested hand-carrying research antibodies to China
item.description: Emails reveal Wuhan virologist Zhengli Shi asked a U.S. collaborator to hand-carry antibodies to China, bypassing formal shipping protocols.

item.title: FOI lawsuits on origins of Covid-19, gain-of-function research and biolabs
item.description: U.S. Right to Know has filed these FOI lawsuits a part of our investigation into origins of Covid-19 and gain-of-function research.

item.title: Critiques of Gates Foundation's agricultural interventions in Africa
item.description: Fact sheet on the Gates Foundation links to resources from African groups, researchers, food security experts describing Bill Gates problematic interventions in African food systems.

item.title: Five ways that transparency failures harm our health
item.description: Five transparency failings – FOIA shortcomings, weak congressional oversight, dark money, poor lobbying disclosure and court secrecy – harm our health.

item.title: FOI documents on origins of Covid-19, gain-of-function research and biolabs
item.description: Freedom of information documents from our investigation into the origins of Covid-19, gain-of-function and biolab risks.

item.title: PR firm linked to Gates-backed AGRA edited Wikipedia to remove criticism
item.description: Investigation reveals PR firm linked to Gates-backed AGRA used fake Wikipedia accounts to delete criticism and research showing it failed to meet its goals.
